title: Forgified Reinforced Barrels
description: Add Reinforced Barrels, this mod is a port to Forge/Neoforge of Reinforced Barrels mod (Aton-Kish)
body:
# Forgified Reinforced Barrels

A Forge/NeoForge port and fork of the original Reinforced Barrels mod by Aton-Kish.

This mod adds upgraded barrel variants with larger storage capacities, allowing players to store more items in a compact and convenient way.

This fork doesn't have the configuration for larg chest GUI, so read the **Important Notice** Section to make chest GUI compatible with your PC screen.

## Barrel Types

Like the original Reinforced Barrels mod, this fork adds several upgraded barrels:

| Barrel Type       | Storage Size | Special Features |
|-------------------|--------------|------------------|
| Copper Barrel     | 45 Slots     | Early-game storage upgrade |
| Iron Barrel       | 54 Slots     | Medium storage capacity |
| Gold Barrel       | 81 Slots     | Large storage capacity |
| Diamond Barrel    | 108 Slots    | Very large storage |
| Netherite Barrel  | 108 Slots    | Blast, fire, and lava resistant |

![Barrels!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/EUbWkfZN/images/f25f1bd63ec2c17cf1a26c76d6baf60244c55416.png)

![Netherite Barrel Storage!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/EUbWkfZN/images/4f50790a3558d44225a80f14ed2233ebf504b959.png)

## Crafting Progression

Table and Images [original project](https://modrinth.com/mod/reinforced-barrels)

| Name             | Type            | Ingredients                      | Recipe                                                                                                 | Description                                                                                             |
| ---------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Copper Barrel    | Shaped Crafting | Barrel + Copper Ingot            | ![Copper Barrel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aton-Kish/reinforced-barrels/1.19/images/recipes/copper_barrel.png)            | A copper barrels has a container inventory with 45 slots.                                               |
| Iron Barrel      | Shaped Crafting | Copper Barrel + Iron Ingot       | ![Iron Barrel ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aton-Kish/reinforced-barrels/1.19/images/recipes/iron_barrel.png)                  | An iron barrels has a container inventory with 54 slots.                                                |
| Gold Barrel      | Shaped Crafting | Iron Barrel + Gold Ingot         | ![Gold Barrel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aton-Kish/reinforced-barrels/1.19/images/recipes/gold_barrel.png)                  | A gold barrels has a container inventory with 81 slots.                                                 |
| Diamond Barrel   | Shaped Crafting | Gold Barrel + Diamond            | ![Diamond Barrel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aton-Kish/reinforced-barrels/1.19/images/recipes/diamond_barrel.png)             | A diamond barrels has a container inventory with 108 slots.                                             |
| Netherite Barrel | Smithing        | Diamond Barrel + Netherite Ingot | ![Netherite Barrel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aton-Kish/reinforced-barrels/1.19/images/recipes/netherite_barrel_smithing.png) | A netherite barrel has a container inventory with 108 slots. This is resistant to blast, fire and lava. |

## Important Notice

This fork does not include the configurable GUI features from the original mod. (because it was made with MCreator)

For large barrel GUIs (Gold, Diamond, Netherite):

- Set GUI Scale to 2 in fullscreen mode
- Set GUI Scale to 1 in windowed mode

This ensures the inventory fits properly on smaller screens.
